title: viola tricolor var. lejeunei
intro: Viola tricolor var. lejeunei, commonly known as Pansy Violet, is a plant species of the viola genus. This perennial herb is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola tricolor var. lejeunei include soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
